text:
anya: quick sync  infra flagged a delivery risk for next milestone. need to lock an MVP acceptance plan today. do we slice or delay?

jorge: high-level: autoscaler patch + kernel regression. full fix+QA -> ~9 business days. we can mitigate with config, but must define explicit acceptance criteria.

maria: correct. i'll own an "autoscaler safe-config" that avoids the risky codepath. it reduces throughput but stabilizes p95.

kevin: ops perspective: if we go safe-config we need: canary ramp plan, route-level tracing, tenant throttles, and an emergency rollback playbook.

lina: product: two customers require tenant SSO; dropping it hurts sales, but pilot is possible. prioritize embcache (latency wins) over telemetry export.

sam: engineering preference: keep embcache, cut telemetry export, offer SSO pilot. but we need measurable launch gates.

anya: propose acceptance matrix (draft):
- Gate A: Perf SLOs (p95 < 900ms, p99 < 2s) on 30m synthetic run + 1h canary under 10% prod traffic.
- Gate B: Error budget delta < 0.5% vs baseline over 1h canary.
- Gate C: Tracing shows no single route >60% of CPU on canary.
- Gate D: Throttle active: per-tenant rps <= 200 for first 48h.
- Gate E: Rollback policy validated and tested in staging.

jorge: add Gate F: embcache warm-path hit rate >= 85% during canary (to protect latency).

maria: agree. i'll add verification scripts and staging smoke tests for all gates.

kevin: canary schedule suggestion: 1% -> 5% after 10m if Gate A/B pass -> 25% after 90m if stable -> full within 4 hrs. each jump gated by automated checks.

lina: comms: we'll call this a "controlled launch" and provide an "SSO pilot" opt-in with manual onboarding. drafting email + FAQ.

sam: what about rollback triggers? need exact numeric thresholds.

kevin: rollback triggers (concrete):
- infra p95 > 1.2s AND error-rate increase > 0.8% over 5m => automatic route fallback to stable pool
- if fallback doesn't reduce p95 by 30% within 3m => initiate autoscaler rollback procedure
- any single tenant causing >40% of error volume => immediate tenant quarantine and rate-limit

anya: good. add an operator-friendly playbook with exact commands and runbook links.

maria: i'll produce the playbook and smoke-test it in staging by Thu EOD.

jorge: milestone tracking: update roadmap board with a "trimmed MVP" card and link owners + gates. if any gate fails during canary we go to rollback and pause rollout.

lina: sales ops: i'll send pilot invites to the two customers and prep manual SSO onboarding checklist.

sam: devdocs: i'll add feature-flag toggles for telemetry export and throttle controls. will also add a QA checklist for embcache.

release-bot: Release window remains. Canary automation ticket assigned to ops.

anya: decision: ship trimmed MVP (cut telemetry export; defer tenant SSO to pilot), keep embcache, adopt autoscaler safe-config, enforce acceptance matrix + canary + rollback triggers. owners: maria (safe-config & playbook), kevin (canary automation & rollback scripts), sam (devdocs & flags), lina (customer pilot comms).

anya: action items + due dates:
- maria: autoscaler safe-config + rollback playbook, staging smoke tests  due Thu EOD
- kevin: canary automation + rollback script + quarantine flow  due Tue noon
- sam: feature flags & telemetry toggle, QA checklist for embcache  due Wed EOB
- lina: SSO pilot comms + onboarding checklist  due Wed noon
- jorge: update roadmap board & launch ticket with gates attached  due Fri

anya: reconvene Fri 9:30am for go/no-go unless any blocker appears. :thumbsup:
